structured_output.what_is_happening: GoonPhil is a pump.fun coin about 11 minutes old, still on its bonding curve. It has risen about 800% to roughly $32k market cap, with about $80k of volume and 372 unique buyers. The curve is at about 80% (91.7 of 115 virtual SOL). The creator has already sold out, a community takeover (CTO) is flagged, it has a website and an X account, and nothing is paid-promoted. Five older same-name coins from the past day are all dead, and this one is currently leading the meme.

narrative.description: 'Goon Phil' ('Oui madame. Goon forever.') looks like a French-flavoured viral meme about some 'Phil' figure. Several copycat coins were launched over the past day, so there is some meme demand. This coin is the first to get real traction.
narrative.why_spreading: The meme seems to be making the rounds. This version has the most complete set of links (website and X) and is now the one people are buying. Other coins with the same name got as high as about $68k before dying.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has by far the most volume and liquidity of any coin with this name, plus its own website, an X account (@goonphilx) and a DexScreener profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Six earlier or parallel coins use this name (GOONPHIL/Goon Jean Phil, Goon-phil, GP, Goonphile, goon Phil). All of them have essentially zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: The buying is broad: 372 unique buyers and 238 unique sellers in about 11 minutes, and the top 10 holders own about 16% (not counting the curve). There are no paid boosts, KOL (influencer) wallets or smart-money wallets. On the other side, GMGN tags 45 bundler wallets, puts the bot/degen share at 43%, and says the top bundlers hold about 12%. The creator has sold everything.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X or Telegram content, so I can't tell whether the wide spread of buyers is real retail interest or a bot swarm.

structural_risks: The creator has already sold out; dev holdings are 0.
The coin will soon finish the curve and move to a PumpSwap pool, and heavy selling right after that move is common.
About 43% of wallets are bots or degens.
In the last 5 minutes on GeckoTerminal the price is flat, just under the all-time high.

structured_output.counterargument: Hitting 2x from about a $32k entry probably means the coin has to leave the curve and keep being bought on PumpSwap, and many coins get sold down right after that move. Bundlers and bots can take profits at any time. Five same-name coins already died, so the meme may be worn out. On the other side, a coin this young with this many buyers, links and no paid promotion is the typical profile of one that graduates and runs 3-5x.

structured_output.thesis: This is a young coin with broad early buying, a clean structure, no paid promotion, and a meme that has already produced copycats. It is close to graduating, which gives it a real path to 2x. The risks are the dev having sold out, the bundler share, and heavy selling after migration. I put its runner chance somewhat above a typical coin in this pool.
